scope: 1996 Ford 4.9L SFI factory workshop manual comparison; not direct proof of identical 1994 fasteners or installed truck hardware.

recovered_primary_figure.identity: Factory 1996 Engine, 4.9L SFI page 03-01A-7, Engine Components, Upper, figure A10700-E. One scanned page, not missing figure A24051-A.
observations: Item 66 is a spanning lifting-eye bracket with two feet and a lifting opening above the manifold. The front manifold is item 65; rear manifold is item 67.
Two separate fasteners are drawn at the eye feet: a projecting stud at one end and a headed bolt at the other. Their leader paths terminate at front-manifold end mounting regions.
The bracket is not a miniature annular eye retained at only a single station. Combined with the 1994 installation text, this supports a stud-13 and bolt-14 retained front-eye comparison topology.
The view does not expose every shared intake/exhaust clamping contact or define a washer stack, clamp thickness, production hole coordinates or section dimensions.
recovered_primary_figure.limits: Year-specific continuity is an inference; dimensional table and visual figure remain 1996 comparison evidence. No figure pixel dimensions are scaled into model geometry.
